scenarios.name: AdventureWorksDW Sales/Margin Territory validation
scenarios.description: Six-query AdventureWorksDW scenario for O_AW_BIKES_EUROPE_MONTH_TERRITORY_MARGIN. It validates useful ALLOW queries for SalesAmount, TotalProductCost and GrossMargin, plus out-of-objective, bad-grain and redundant BLOCK cases. The number of queries is illustrative, not fixed by MCAD.

queries.label: AW Q1 — ALLOW SalesAmount by month and territory
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q2 — ALLOW TotalProductCost by month and territory
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[TotalProductCost]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q3 — ALLOW GrossMargin by month and territory
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[GrossMargin]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q4 — BLOCK Accessories instead of Bikes
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Month].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Accessories], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q5 — BLOCK Year grain instead of Month grain
queries.mdx: SELECT {[Measures].[SalesAmount]} ON COLUMNS, CrossJoin([Date].[Calendar].[Calendar Year].Members, [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Region].Members) ON ROWS FROM [Adventure Works DW] WHERE ([Product].[Product Category].[Bikes], [Sales Territory].[Sales Territory Group].[Europe], [Date].[Calendar Year].[2013])

queries.label: AW Q6 — BLOCK redundant SalesAmount after Q1
